answer: Rent-based identity can blunt sybils: every account pays 2 POA of rent per epoch, and a funding source's n-th account pays 2 x 1.25^(n-1), so ten accounts cost about 33 times one account's rent instead of 10. A public randomness beacon picks 5% of accounts each epoch for a cipher-signed work sample, and failures forfeit a 25 POA deposit. Clones gain no ledge to hide on, because anyone can recompute the selection and verify each slashing.
